fills.researcher_notes: Diamond East Project (~50 mi Leidy-system looping + compression, ~1,000 MMcf/d, Luzerne/Lycoming Cos PA to Mercer Co NJ) never reached a FERC application. Williams ran a binding open season Aug 26-Sep 23, 2014 (Natural Gas Intelligence, worldpipelines.com) with the route explicitly 'not yet finalized' (Delaware Riverkeeper Network project page, delawareriverkeeper.org -- verified 200, not cited as the value source since it carries no diameter either). No CP docket for 'Diamond East' exists in FERC eLibrary or Federal Register (searched both); EIA's own Oct 2019 note calls it 'assumed cancelled' with no post-2014 activity. Because the project died before the engineering/EA stage that is this country's usual diameter source (RESEARCH_PROTOCOL gotcha), no pipe diameter was ever made public for this route -- this is a genuine absence of data, not a case of gotcha 3's compression-only blank-is-correct (the open-season materials describe new looping, i.e. new pipe was intended). Searched: FERC eLibrary docket search on 'Diamond East', Federal Register notices, Williams/Transco newsroom archive, NGI and trade-press archives, EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects table. UNRESOLVED -- nothing found, not something conflicting found.
